meta.title: Census 2021 small-area labour-market, skills, care and disability profile
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics (Census 2021, ~97% person response, estimates adjusted for non-response). LA, region and England rows are the published LA-level figures; BEDS sums the three LA counts and recomputes %.
meta.limitations: Census day 21 March 2021 fell in the third COVID-19 lockdown: furloughed people were counted as employed (temporarily away), labour-market activity may differ from normal, and students were counted at their term-time address (some were living elsewhere). Cell-key perturbation adds small noise to every cell, so LSOA counts do not sum exactly to LA totals and very small counts (<10) are unreliable; LSOA-to-LA sums differ slightly from LA rows. 2021 LSOAs differ from 2011 LSOAs (splits/merges), so direct comparison with 2011 needs the ONS LSOA11->LSOA21 lookup. Inactive/unemployed definitions use the ILO-style Census questions for the week before Census day; 'unemployed' includes full-time students seeking work. Hidden-potential pool = LT sick or disabled + looking after home/family + other (all 16+, incl. 65+).
